name: F1_brk_ridge_filter frozen scorecard (trained on all in-sample candidates of us100+ger40+xauusd+btcusd, decisions before 2021-12-27)
score: intercept + sum_i coef_i * clip((x_i - mean_i) / std_i, -4, +4) + sum_j coef_j * dummy_j ; trade the candidate if score >= threshold

feature_definitions.session bars: H1 BID bars starting 02:00..15:00 New-York time Mon-Fri (FP server hours 09..22). S[0] = bar just closed, S[k] = k session bars earlier
feature_definitions.side: +1 if close(S[0]) > max high(S[1..14]) ; -1 if close(S[0]) < min low(S[1..14])
feature_definitions.brk: (close - max high(S[1..14])) / A for a long ; (min low(S[1..14]) - close) / A for a short
feature_definitions.pos: long: (close - LL) / (HH - LL) ; short: (HH - close) / (HH - LL), HH/LL = max high / min low of S[0..279]
feature_definitions.seq: number of bars among S[1..14] that were breakouts in the SAME direction (close beyond the 14-bar channel of the bars before them)
feature_definitions.opp: same count for the OPPOSITE direction
feature_definitions.pdd: long: (close - previous session day's high) / A ; short: (previous session day's low - close) / A (session bars of the previous New-York date that has bars)
feature_definitions.dret: side * (close - last session close of the previous session day) / A
